applicant.organisation: Medical University of Vienna, Department of Epidemiology

purpose: Research on kidney-protective treatment in diabetic hypertension.
question: How many patients with hypertension and type 2 diabetes have no active ACE inhibitor, by region?
definitions: Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
ACE inhibitor = ATC code starting with C09AA.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per region: patients with hypertension and type 2 diabetes, how many of them have no active ACE inhibitor and that share in %, one decimal.
